reasons: Both answers propose nearly identical staged pipelines with evidence-backed rollout fields, coverage checks, pre-filtering, small-model batch extraction and a PM review artifact, and both give a clear 'no' on the Opus-plus-examples idea. B is slightly more direct about catching early classification errors: it surfaces every LLM-classified-internal PR for PM review and keeps a full drop log. B also closes the silent-omission gap more cleanly by making the writer include every item and doing length truncation in code. A's approach, asking the writer to list omitted items with reasons, is sound but leaves the omission decision with the model.
